title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space industry is buzzing with activity as new partnerships form and budget allocations shift. From satellite production collaborations to lunar lander missions, the momentum is palpable, albeit with a few delays in hypersonic testing.

themes.title: Satellite Production Partnerships
themes.body: Fastrastra and Hadrian's collaboration aims to streamline satellite production, a necessary move as demand surges. This could signal a trend toward consolidation in an industry that often resembles a crowded marketplace.

themes.title: Lunar Ambitions Continue
themes.body: H3's upcoming lunar lander mission underscores the ongoing interest in lunar exploration, even as budgets tighten. The race to establish a foothold on the Moon is heating up, with both established players and newcomers vying for a piece of the pie.

themes.title: Space Resilience Funding Boost
themes.body: The FY27 budget markup adds $1.4 billion to the space resilience line, reflecting a growing recognition of the strategic importance of space. This influx of cash may bolster domestic capabilities, but it remains to be seen how effectively it will be utilized.

themes.title: Commercial SSA Rush
themes.body: Chinese startups are entering the space situational awareness market, joining a growing list of players. This influx could intensify competition and innovation, but also raises questions about data security and geopolitical implications.
